## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-census-a2a-card`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-census-a2a-card -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `data/cards.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `record.json`
- `record.json.ots`
- `record.ots.json`
- `record.signed.json`
- `record.v0.1.1.json`
- `record.2026-09-27.json`
- `record.2026-10-04.json`
- See the Data tab for all 51 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

> **Current record: 0.1.1** — `record.v0.1.1.json`, sha256 `4a2b46bb42aa727363ca04d8a2cc21ed76b50a4c6937a62f80d6fcfda191af91`, supersedes `record.json` (0.1, sha256 `b290b53d05912d8b3a5913c7e73e693f40cc71be8e0432c4626643c6d662176c`), which stays published unchanged. Figures in sections 1–3 are 0.1 unless the Corrections section below restates them; the dataset viewer loads the 0.1.1 rows (`data/cards.v0.1.1.jsonl.gz`).
